end.summary:
Discussed health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only absence of disease.
Siya identified the three dimensions: physical, mental and social.
Applied the idea to an example involving late phone use, missed breakfast, low energy and irritability.
Initially repeated the misconception that not being sick means being healthy; later corrected it using the three-legged stool analogy.
Teach-back was not fully passed; unaided correct attempts: 0/2.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three parts of health with Siya and used everyday examples and a three-legged stool analogy. Siya first mixed up “not sick” with “healthy,” then corrected the idea by explaining that mental and social well-being are also needed. At home, ask Siya to give one example each of physical, mental and social well-being from a daily routine.
